title: Best AI Recruitment Software in 2027: 10 Tools Ranked
summary: Compare 10 AI recruitment software tools by hiring step, pricing, and G2 rating, and see which one fits your hiring volume, ATS, and team.
body_markdown:
AI recruitment software uses machine learning and language models to do recruiting work that used to need a person: reading applications, asking screening questions, ranking candidates, and sending updates. It sits on top of, or inside, your applicant tracking system. Recruiters still set the criteria, review the output, and make every hiring decision.


For a talent acquisition leader, the useful question is not whether a tool uses AI. It is which step the AI owns, and what the tool does when the AI is turned off. A tool that only adds a summary button to an ATS changes little. A tool that interviews every applicant within minutes changes how long candidates wait. This guide sorts tools by the hiring step they handle so you can match the tool to your bottleneck. For platforms that cover the whole hiring process, see[talent acquisition platforms](https://www.peoplebox.ai/blog/best-talent-acquisition-platforms-2025/) .


### How is AI recruitment software different from an ATS with AI features?


An ATS with AI features is a system of record that stores jobs, candidates, and stages, and adds AI to help with parts of them. Dedicated AI recruitment software does one step, such as interviewing or sourcing, and sends results back to the ATS. Many teams run both. Our guide to the[best applicant tracking systems](https://www.peoplebox.ai/blog/best-applicant-tracking-systems/) compares the system-of-record side in detail.


### What is talent acquisition software, and how is it different?


Talent acquisition software is a broader suite that covers sourcing, applicant tracking, interviewing, and hiring workflows in one system. AI recruitment software is the AI layer that automates specific steps inside that process. Some talent acquisition suites include AI features, and many teams add dedicated AI tools on top.
